status: Independent engine and HTTP review actions match opaque and translucent native corpora. GUI controls, skip preference and observed navigation are verified in review-ui-contract.json. Full application parity remains unfinished.

verification.knownFailure: Existing processing-batch-controls setter-only backgroundMode 2 comparison; unchanged.

behavior.pages: Native 17 is advanced Export Result, 18 is basic Export Result, 19 is Review Result and 15 is Remove Background. Automatic/basic completion enters Review unless the saved skip checkbox is checked. Leaving background removal enters advanced Export or basic Review, even when Skip is checked.
behavior.artwork: Choice 0 sets category 1 and fixed palette mode, searches palette candidates and enters the basic palette page. Candidate completion may choose a new palette and update its metadata.
behavior.quality: Choices 1, 2 and 3 select quality 0, 1 and 2, then run the existing segmentation, smoothing and fitting path. Matching keys reuse work. They preserve the selected palette and recommendation state.
behavior.colors: Choice 4 selects fixed palette mode and opens basic palette selection. Choice 5 selects flexible palette mode and reruns segmentation through fitting. Neither invokes automatic reclassification.
behavior.edit: Choice 6 enters the existing segmentation editor. Choice 7 returns to image type selection with the current controls. Choice 8 enters the existing background editor.
behavior.api: GuiEngine.review and POST /api/review accept one named action: artwork, high, medium, low, custom-colors, unlimited-colors, edit, hand-pick or background. They return the resulting document, selected controls and destination page. Validation precedes mutation. Batch ownership blocks the single-image command.

referenceLimitations: Native action captures call MainModel::troubleShoot directly through its Qt method. Assembly proves the sender argument is unused, so the observer passes null instead of driving a widget.
The existing observation-only show routine sets WA_DontShowOnScreen on a private desktop. No native button input or dialog answer is synthesized.
Hidden-window Next and Back do nothing; visible-on-private-desktop captures establish actual navigation admission. Both corpora are retained.
GUI controls and Skip are verified separately in review-ui-contract.json. Customized history cases and complete window parity remain unfinished.
